description: Retrieves information about the current user or a specific user in Salesforce.

include_permissions.description: Whether to include user permissions in the response (requires additional API call). Requires elevated access; permission data is returned inside salesforce_user_details and may be partially masked based on the user's profile.
include_permissions.human_parameter_description: Choose this if you also want profile, role, and permission-related details for the user. It may take slightly longer because it performs an extra lookup.
include_permissions.title: Include Permissions

user_id.description: The Salesforce User ID to retrieve information for. If not provided, returns current user info.
user_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce User ID of the person you want details for. Leave this blank to get information about your own account.
user_id.title: User Id

name: get_user_info

GetUserInfoResponse.description: Response containing comprehensive user information from Salesforce.

push_service_type.description: Optional array of push notification provider types configured for the user.
push_service_type.title: Push Service Type

username.description: The queried user's login name or email.
username.title: Username

mobile_phone.description: Mobile phone number from user settings.
mobile_phone.title: Mobile Phone

mobile_policy.description: Optional mobile application policy settings for the user.
mobile_policy.title: Mobile Policy

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the user information was last updated. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
updated_at.title: Updated At

mobile_phone_verified.description: Whether the user has confirmed mobile phone validity.
mobile_phone_verified.title: Mobile Phone Verified

urls.description: Map of various API endpoint URLs available to the user.
urls.title: Urls

is_app_installed.description: Optional field indicating whether the connected app is installed for the user.
is_app_installed.title: Is App Installed

sub.description: Subject identifier claim. The unique identifier for the user in OpenID Connect format.
sub.title: Sub

status.description: Current Chatter status of the user.
status.title: Status

custom_permissions.description: Optional map of custom permissions enabled in the organization.
custom_permissions.title: Custom Permissions

name.description: Full name of the user. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
name.title: Name

given_name.description: User's given (first) name. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
given_name.title: Given Name

nick_name.description: Experience Cloud nickname of the user.
nick_name.title: Nick Name

last_modified_date.description: ISO timestamp of when the user record was last modified.
last_modified_date.title: Last Modified Date

utcOffset.description: UTC offset in milliseconds from user's timezone setting.
utcOffset.title: Utc Offset

family_name.description: User's family (last) name. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
family_name.title: Family Name

custom_attributes.description: Optional custom attributes configured for the organization.
custom_attributes.title: Custom Attributes

zoneinfo.description: User's time zone. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
zoneinfo.title: Zoneinfo

preferred_username.description: The username by which the end-user wants to be referred to at the client application.
preferred_username.title: Preferred Username

photos.description: URLs to the user's profile pictures.
photos.title: Photos

email_verified.description: Indicates whether the queried user's email was verified by clicking a link.
email_verified.title: Email Verified

picture.description: URL to user's profile picture. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
picture.title: Picture

asserted_user.description: Indicates whether the access token was issued for this identity.
asserted_user.title: Asserted User

addr_state.description: State or province from user settings.
addr_state.title: Addr State

user_id.description: The queried user's unique Salesforce ID.
user_id.title: User Id

profile.description: URL to user's profile page. Part of OpenID Connect standard claims.
profile.title: Profile

active.description: Whether the user account is active.
active.title: Active

id.description: Identity URL, which is the same URL that was queried. Format: https://login.salesforce.com/id/{organization_id}/{user_id}
id.title: Id

salesforce_user_details.description: Additional Salesforce user details including profile, role, and permission fields. Only populated when include_permissions is True.
salesforce_user_details.title: Salesforce User Details

organization_id.description: ID of the user's Salesforce organization.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

GetUserInfoResponse.title: GetUserInfoResponse

UserPhotos.description: URLs to the user's profile pictures.

picture.description: URL to the full-size profile picture.
picture.title: Picture

thumbnail.description: URL to the thumbnail-size profile picture.
thumbnail.title: Thumbnail

UserPhotos.title: UserPhotos

UserStatus.description: Current Chatter status of the user.

createdDate.description: ISO timestamp when the status was created.
createdDate.title: Created Date

UserStatus.title: UserStatus

UserUrls.description: Map of various API endpoint URLs available to the user.

enterprise.description: SOAP API enterprise WSDL endpoint URL.
enterprise.title: Enterprise

partner.description: SOAP API partner WSDL endpoint URL.
partner.title: Partner
